64800.meaning1: trainee; apprentice; learner; initiate; (comm) seven stages of a noble person before arahantship
64800.meaning2: learner, who is in the course of perfection
64800.commentary: (SNPa) sekhā'ti, sīl'ādīni sikkhamānā avasesā ariyapuggalā. (VINa) sekho'ti puthujjanakalyāṇakena saddhiṃ satta ariyā tisso sikkhā sikkhantī'ti sekhā.

examples.text: sekho pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, sekho dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.
ye ca saṅkhātadhammāse, ye ca sekhā puthū idha, tesaṃ me nipako iriyaṃ, puṭṭho pabrūhi mārisa.

64801.meaning1: power of a trainee; strength of an initiate

examples.text: so imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati, saddhābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, paññābalaṃ. tass'imāni pañc'indriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti, saddh'indriyaṃ, vīriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ.

64802.meaningLit: section on the power of a trainee

64803.meaning1: stage of a trainee; learner level

examples.text: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, atthi nu kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sekho'smī'ti pajāneyya, asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito asekho'smī'ti pajāneyyā'ti?
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo samaṇam'acalo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sekho hoti pāṭipado [paṭipado ma. ni. 2 sekhasuttavaṇṇanā oloketabbā]

64809.meaning1: who is training; who is learning

64810.meaning1: giving confidence to a trainee; providing assurance to an initiate

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, assaddhassa sārajjaṃ hoti, saddhassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti. tasm'āyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo.

64811.meaning1: related to training; to be practised

examples.text: ime kho pan'āyasmanto sekhiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto sekhiyā dhammā. tatth'āyasmante pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, dutiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, tatiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā

64813.meaning1: section on training rules; chapter on rules of conduct

examples.text: atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā sāṇo ca sekhuniyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

64816.commentary: (ANa) ath'assa siṅgālasaddo'y'eva nicchari. tena vuttaṃ, siṅgālakaṃ'y'eva nadatī'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso sarabha, brahāraññe jarasiṅgālo sīhanādaṃ nadissāmī'ti segālakaṃ'y'eva nadati, bheraṇḍakaṃ'y'eva nadati

64818.commentary: (JAa) secanenā'ti tena vuttesu brāhmaṇadhammesu ekaṃ dassetvā sabbaṃ paṭikkhipati. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, aggiparicaraṇena vā udakasecanena vā pasughātayaññena vā suddhi nāma n'atthi, n'āpi ettakena brāhmaṇo kevalaparipuṇṇo hoti, na adhivāsanakhan'ti, na sīlasoraccaṃ, n'āpi kilesaparinibbānena parinibbuto nāma hotī'ti.

examples.text: na suddhi secanen'atthi, n'āpi kevalī brāhmaṇo, na khantī n'āpi soraccaṃ, n'āpi so parinibbuto.

64819.meaning1: foremost (among); best (of); primary; most important; supreme (among)
64819.commentary: (MNa) seṭṭho… uttamo (SNa) so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti so khīṇ'āsavabrāhmaṇo devesu ca manussesu ca seṭṭho uttamo'ti.

examples.text: pamādam'anuyuñjanti, bālā dummedhino janā, appamādañ'ca medhāvī, dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ'va rakkhati.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti.
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.

64821.meaning1: foremost lifestyle; highest state of being

64822.meaning2: fact of being the highest state of life

64823.meaning1: what is the foremost lifestyle; what is the highest state of being

examples.text: appamādena maghavā, devānaṃ seṭṭhataṃ gato, appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, pamādo garahito sadā.

64828.meaning1: giving the best; providing the foremost

examples.text: yo aggadāyī varadāyī, seṭṭhadāyī ca yo naro, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.
tatr'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo sāṅgaṇo'va samāno atthi me ajjhattaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sāṅgaṇānaṃ'y'eva sataṃ seṭṭhapuriso akkhāyati.

64833.meaning1: associating with the best; attending the finest; paying respect to the foremost; (comm) bowing down to the foremost man

examples.text: nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham'upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā'ti.

64834.commentary: (JAa) sa ve naro seṭṭham'upeti ṭhānan'ti so uttamaṃ ṭhānaṃ upeti adhigacchati vindati labhatī'ti.

examples.text: manāpadāyī labhate manāpaṃ, aggassa dātā labhate punaggaṃ, varassa dātā varalābhi hoti, seṭṭhaṃ dado seṭṭham'upeti ṭhānaṃ.
na ve sugaṇhaṃ paṭhamena seṭṭhaṃ, kaniṭṭhamāpāthagataṃ gahetvā, yo cīdha tacchaṃ paviceyya gaṇhati, sa ve naro seṭṭham'upeti ṭhānaṃ.
daliddo puriso rāja, saddho hoti amaccharī, dadāti seṭṭhasaṅkappo, abyaggamanaso naro.

64836.commentary: (DNa) hīnasammatan'ti mante dhārenti mante vācentī'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, idaṃ tena samayena hīnasammataṃ. tadeta'r'ahi seṭṭhasammatan'ti taṃ idāni ettake mante dhārenti ettake mante vācentī'ti seṭṭhasammataṃ jātaṃ.

examples.text: na dān'ime jhāyantī'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, ajjhāyakā ajjhāyakā tv'eva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ. hīnasammataṃ kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena hoti, tadeta'r'ahi seṭṭhasammataṃ.

64837.meaning2: position of a foreman of a guild

64838.meaning1: rich merchant; wealthy man; distinguished man; man of authority

examples.text: patthitā rājaputtehi, seṭṭhiputtehi gijjhitā, pitu me pesayī dūtaṃ, detha mayhaṃ anopamaṃ.
bodhisattassa vacanaṃ sutvā seṭṭhi kampamāno dhanasokena satiṃ paccupaṭṭhāpetuṃ asakkonto tatth'eva pati

kathañ'hi nāma satto sattassa evarūpaṃ karissatī'ti! tadeta'r'ahi'pi manussā ekaccesu janapadesu vadhuyā nibbuyhamānāya aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti, aññe seṭṭhiṃ khipanti, aññe gomayaṃ khipanti. tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anusaranti, na tv'ev'assa atthaṃ ājānanti.

64841.meaning1: position of business executive; position of treasurer

examples.text: seṭṭhi, sace me dhītā vijāyissati, tāya naṃ saddhiṃ nivesetvā seṭṭhiṭṭhānassa sāmikaṃ karissāmi. sace me putto vijāyissati, māressāmi nan'ti cintetvā taṃ gehe kāresi.

64842.meaning1: position of treasurer; office of financier

examples.text: tass'eva kammassa vipāk'āvasesena imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā sattakkhattuṃ seṭṭhittaṃ kāresi.

64843.meaning1: son of a business executive; son of a wealthy man

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ yaso nāma kulaputto seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti. tassa tayo pāsādā honti, eko hem'antiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.
atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhibhariyāya sattavassikaṃ sīs'ābādhaṃ eken'eva natthukammena apakaḍḍhi.
santapaṇītadhammapaccavekkhaṇavasena uppannattā. yathā hi rājavallabho cūḷ'upaṭṭhāko appaṭihārikaṃ yathāsukhaṃ rājakulaṃ pavisanto seṭṭhisenāpati-ādayo pādena paharanto'pi na gaṇeti.

64847.meaning1: rich merchant; wealthy man; distinguished man; man of authority

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū yena rājagahako seṭṭhī ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā rājagahakaṃ seṭṭhiṃ etadavocuṃ
sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni

64851.meaning1: name of a mountain peak in the Himalayas
64851.commentary: (SNa) seto'ti kelāso. (SNt) seto'ti kelāsakūṭo adhippeto'ti āha, seto'ti kelāso'ti.

examples.text: vipulo rājagahīyānaṃ, giriseṭṭho pavuccati, seto himavataṃ seṭṭho, ādicco aghagāminaṃ.

64852.commentary: (ANa) seto nāma nāgo'ti setavaṇṇatāya evaṃ laddhanāmo hatthināgo.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa seto nāma nāgo mahātūriyatāḷitavāditena pubbakoṭṭhakā paccuttarati.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā.

64856.meaning1: name of the Bodhisatta in Tusita heaven

examples.text: agārino annada-pānavatthadā, avhāyikā tam'pi disaṃ vadanti, esā disā paramā setaketu, yaṃ patvā dukkhī sukhino bhavanti.

64858.meaning1: white parasol; white sunshade; white umbrella; symbol of dignity
64858.meaning2: white parasol, which is an emblem of royalty

examples.text: chattaṃ nāma tīṇi chattāni, setacchattaṃ, kilañjacchattaṃ, paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
hatthikkhandhagato āsiṃ, setacchattaṃ var'uttamaṃ, sucārurūpaṃ disvāna, vitti me udapajjatha.

64859.meaning1: strewn with bleached bones; covered with carcasses
64859.commentary: (VINa) set'aṭṭhikā'ti setakāni aṭṭhīni etthā'ti set'aṭṭhikā. divasam'pi yācitvā kiñci aladdhā matānaṃ kapaṇamanussānaṃ ahicchattakavaṇṇehi aṭṭhīhi tatra tatra parikiṇṇā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. set'aṭṭikā'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, setā aṭṭi etthā'ti set'aṭṭikā.
64859.notes: Found in the stock description of a famine.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena nāḷandā dubbhikkhā hoti dvīhitikā set'aṭṭhikā salākāvuttā. tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.

64860.commentary: (VINa) set'aṭṭhikā nāma rogajātī'ti eko pāṇako nāḷimajjhagataṃ kaṇḍaṃ vijjhati, yena viddhattā nikkhantam'pi sālisīsaṃ khīraṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti.

64863.commentary: (ANa) upekkhāsetadantavā'ti cha'ḷ'aṅg'upekkhāmayehi setadantehi samannāgato. (THa) suparisuddhavedanā ñāṇappabhedā upekkhā setadantā te etassa atthī'ti, upekkhāsetadantavā

examples.text: sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.

64865.commentary: (SNa) setapacchādo'ti setapaṭicchādano. (UDa) seto pacchādo etassā'ti setapacchādo. pacchādo'ti rathassa upari attharitabbakambal'ādi. so pana suparisuddhadhavalabhāvena seto vā hoti rattanīlādīsu vā aññataro. idha pana arahattaphalavimuttiyā adhippetattā suparisuddhabhāvaṃ upādāya setapacchādo'ti vuttaṃ yathā aññatrā'pi ratho sīlaparikkhāro'ti.

examples.text: n'el'aṅgo setapacchādo, ek'āro vattatī ratho, anīghaṃ passa āyantaṃ, chinnasotaṃ abandhanan'ti.

64866.commentary: (SNa) setaparivāro'ti yathā aññe rathā sīhacamma-parivārā'pi honti, byagghacamma-parivārā'pi paṇḍukambalaparivārā'pi honti, na evaṃ esa. esa pana ghanadukūlena parivārito ahosi.

examples.text: addasā kho āyasmā ānando jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāyantaṃ. setā sudaṃ assā yuttā honti set'ālaṅ'kārā, seto ratho, setaparivāro, setā rasmiyo, setā patodalaṭṭhi, setaṃ chattaṃ, setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ, setāni vatthāni, setā upāhanā, setāya sudaṃ vālabījaniyā bījīyati.
atha kho setabyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā setabyāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarenamukhā gacchanti yena siṃsapāvanaṃ.

64868.commentary: (DNa) setabyā'ti tassa nagarassa nāmaṃ. (DNt) setabyā'ti itthiliṅgavasena tassa nagarassa nāmaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kumārakassapo kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena setabyā nāma kosalānaṃ nagaraṃ tadavasari.

64869.compound: dvanda (seta ca ratta ca nīla ca)

examples.text: ettha ca setarattanīlesu yaṃ kiñci uppalaṃ uppalam'eva. ūnakasatapattaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ, satapattaṃ padumaṃ. pattaniyamaṃ vā vinā'pi setaṃ padumaṃ, rattaṃ puṇḍarīkan'ti ayam'ettha vinicchayo.
ālokasandhiparikammāyā'ti vātapānaparikammāya setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ.

64875.meaning1: with white trappings; having white accessories; (comm) with silver ornamentation

examples.text: setā sudaṃ assā yuttā honti set'ālaṅ'kārā, seto ratho, setaparivāro, setā rasmiyo, setā patodalaṭṭhi, setaṃ chattaṃ, setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ, setāni vatthāni, setā upāhanā, setāya sudaṃ vālabījaniyā bījīyati. tam'enaṃ jano disvā evam'āha, brahmaṃ vata, bho, yānaṃ!
yadā kho, āvuso, imaṃ kāyaṃ tayo dhammā jahanti, āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, ath'āyaṃ kāyo ujjhito avakkhitto seti, yathā kaṭṭhaṃ acetanan'ti.
āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, yadā kāyaṃ jahant'imaṃ, apaviddho tadā seti, parabhattaṃ acetanaṃ.
uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyya, dhammaṃ sucaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, kāmabhogiseyyā? yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, kāmabhogī vāmena passena senti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kāmabhogiseyyā.

64878.commentary: (DHPa) sukhaṃ setī'ti desanāmattam'ev'etaṃ, catūhi'pi iriyāpathehi sukhaṃ viharatī'ti attho.

examples.text: dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme sadā ramati paṇḍito.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ… na c'assa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya.
ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.

64880.commentary: (SNa) setukārakā'ti visame setuṃ karonti, udake nāvaṃ paṭiyādenti.

examples.text: ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.

64881.meaning1: destruction of the bridge (wrt); demolishing the connection (to)

examples.text: mānasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo mānaṃ nissāya māno pahātabbo. methunasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo. methune ca setughāto vutto bhagavatā.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṃ vo dhammappamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyā'ti.

64883.commentary: (UDa) sīt'odakā'ti sītalajalā. set'odakā'ti nikkaddamā. udakañ'hi sabhāvato setavaṇṇaṃ, bhūmivasena kaddam'āvilatāya ca aññādisaṃ hoti, kakudhā'pi nadī vimalavālikā samokiṇṇā setavaṇṇā sandati. tena vuttaṃ set'odakā'ti.

examples.text: ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā nadī avidūre acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā set'odakā suppatitthā ramaṇīyā.

64884.grammar: aor, reflx 1st sg of sesi, irreg form of sesiṃ, intrans

examples.text: kiṃsū asissāmi kuvaṃ vā asissaṃ, dukkhaṃ vata settha kv'ajja sessaṃ, ete vitakke paridevaneyye, vinayetha sekho aniketacārī.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, dantebhi dantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu.

64886.meaning1: name of a town in Sumbha

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati sedakaṃ nāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.

64889.meaning1: drenched in sweat; bathed in sweat

64891.commentary: (DNa) vāto'va sedataṃ kanto'ti yathā sañjātasedānaṃ sedaharaṇ'atthaṃ vāto iṭṭho hoti kanto manāpo, evan'ti attho.

examples.text: vāto'va sedataṃ kanto, pānīyaṃ'va pipāsato, aṅgīrasi piyāme'si, dhammo arahatām'iva.
tuyhaṃ kho pana, aggivessana, app'ekaccāni sedaphusitāni nalāṭā muttāni, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ vinibhinditvā bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhitāni. mayhaṃ kho pana, aggivessana, n'atthi eta'r'ahi kāyasmiṃ sedo'ti.

64893.meaning1: earned by the sweat of one's brow

examples.text: katamañ'ca, gahapati, atthisukhaṃ? idha, gahapati, kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā.

kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodh'ābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye'pi'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te'pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.

upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni sen'āsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, tathārūpesu bhikkhu sen'āsanesu viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya
yāni ca kho tāni sen'āsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi sen'āsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī'ti

64899.meaning1: with an army; having a military

examples.text: ajj'eva kiccam'ātappaṃ, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
